title: Fallback YAML parser misclassified colon-containing plain sequence scalars after reviewed Python migration
title_de: Fallback-YAML-Parser klassifizierte nach der geprüften Python-Migration Klartext-Listenskalare mit Doppelpunkt falsch
protocol: YAML case parsing and CI runner compatibility
profile: Framework CPython 3.13 updater Draft PR exact-head CI remediation
technical_claim: After this task made test-common use the reviewed Python 3.13 runtime, that runtime did not have PyYAML installed and correctly used the Framework's dependency-free fallback parser. The parser treated every colon in a list scalar as an inline mapping separator, so valid scalar ARGS:foo. became a dict and metadata validation failed.
entry_point: test-common's case_cli list-cases materialization under the reviewed Python runtime.
source_to_sink_or_broken_control: MinimalYamlParser._sequence_value sees a colon in a plain list scalar and unconditionally calls _inline_sequence_mapping; validate_case then rejects the resulting non-string known_limitations value.
attacker_prerequisites: None; valid checked-in YAML with a colon-containing scalar is sufficient.
observed_behavior: Exact-head runs 29774890120 and 29774954997 failed on tests/cases/body/json/json_request_body_block.yaml with known_limitations list must contain strings. PyYAML 6.0.3 parses the same item as a string, confirming the source YAML is valid.
expected_behavior: A colon begins an inline list mapping only when it is a YAML mapping separator (followed by whitespace or end-of-value); ARGS:foo., URLs, and analogous plain scalars remain strings while - name: Content-Type remains a mapping.
impact: The migration exposed a deterministic Framework parser compatibility bug and prevents the required common-structure CI check from completing.
preconditions: The fallback parser is selected because PyYAML is unavailable.
A valid case contains a colon-containing plain list scalar.
reproduction: Run the test-common case materialization with the fallback parser against json_request_body_block.yaml.
Observe ARGS:foo. parse as a dict before metadata validation.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped gh run view 29774954997 --log-failed and focused parser inspection
evidence.summary: The required PR check failed in fallback YAML parsing of the valid ARGS:foo. known-limitations scalar.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped complete remediation validation including fallback parser regression and test-common materialization through the real CLI
evidence.summary: The refined colon separator predicate preserves ARGS:foo. as a scalar and inline name: Content-Type mappings; focused and native validation passed.

root_cause: The fallback parser equated any colon with a mapping separator instead of recognizing YAML's colon-plus-whitespace/end mapping syntax.
proposed_remediation: Narrow _sequence_value's mapping test to the first colon followed by whitespace or end-of-value, and add fallback-parser regression coverage for ARGS:foo. while retaining the existing name: Content-Type mapping control.
acceptance_criteria: Colon-containing plain sequence scalars parse as strings.
Existing inline sequence mappings remain dictionaries.
The focused parser test and test-common materialization succeed under reviewed Python 3.13.
validation_plan: Run the focused parser-hardening test and test-common workflow-contract/materialization checks, then collect a fresh exact-head hosted check.
legitimate_control_tests: Existing - name: Content-Type nested mapping fixture remains unchanged.
bypass_review: Exercise colon followed by whitespace, end-of-value, no whitespace, quoted values, URLs, and a nested mapping continuation.
deduplication_note: No existing local finding owns this new reviewed-runtime fallback-parser failure.
evidence_limitations: The failure is a correctness/parser-compatibility issue, not a demonstrated code-execution or data-exposure exploit.
residual_risk: The local remediation is fixed, but PR delivery remains blocked until the remediated commit is pushed and its exact head passes hosted common-structure and all other required checks.

history.detail: The reviewed Python migration exposed the fallback parser's incorrect colon scalar classification.

The fallback parser now treats a colon as an inline-mapping separator only when followed by whitespace or end-of-value. The ARGS:foo. scalar and name: Content-Type mapping controls, real test-common materialization, focused suite, native full lint, and sealed follow-up scan passed; hosted current-head evidence remains pending.
